title: Joining Speed Webb and the Vitaphone movie band
summary: Gay's band, formerly Willie Jones's, joined Speed Webb who had come back from the Coast; Roy Eldridge, Teddy Wilson and their brothers were in it.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That band joined Steve Rebb (PHONETIC). That's how Steve Rebb (PHONETIC) formed.
I mean -- yeah -- cause he had just came back from the coast, he had a band out on the coast. He didn't bring it back East with him.

I don't know -- maybe the guys wouldn't come with him. I -- I really don't know. But they -- I guess they all liked where they were -- out in Los Angeles. Los Angeles at that time was jumping you know. And all kinds of work was out there.

Movies and things. This was in the late '20s. And we joined his band. And you know he was the first band that had -- first colored band that was in sound. We used to call it videophone -- remember that?
What did I tell you about that?
Well, you mentioned a little bit about it. Was that before you joined the band that they did that -- movie stuff?
Yeah. It was. I was with Steve Webb -- I mean I was with Leonard Gay. (unintelligible). The band wasn't called Leonard Gay's band although Leonard was the music director.
The band was called Willie Jones band.

But, Jones left -- Willie Jones -- I don't know what happened to him. Anyway, we got together -- you know -- with Steve and Steve had very many promises as (unintelligible). But nothing but promises -- that's all. You dig?
So we scuffled and -- you know -- I was in the band and Teddy was in the band. They're brothers. Both had brothers you know and they were in the band.
Joe and I -- Teddy and Gus. Gus played trombone and was a very good arranger. He was a good trombone player too. He was an excellent arranger.
